body: Should it `panic!()` or return `Result` or default to `Style::default().background` with a log message? Also, being able to point where in the line this happens would be nice to debug but I don't know hos to do so.

Shouldn't these tests be moved elsewhere since style resolving is entirely happening in `module.rs` and `config.rs` now? Plus they feel lik they're duplicates of several tests in`config.rs`, for instance `table_get_styles_previous`.
